title: fix(tests): update check_node_builtin_modules output for new @types/node
body:
A new batch of @types/node versions was published to npm today (22.20.3,
24.13.5, 25.9.7, 26.6.1) and the readFileSync overloads changed shape, so
the type error reported for the invalid options argument in this spec test
changed. This updates the expected output to match, same as #36711 did for
the 26.4.0 release. Currently every CI run fails on the
specs::check::check_node_builtin_modules tests on all platforms.
